title: long-term-front-matter/1
description: YAML front matter of $VAULT/memory/long/*.md. The body is free markdown. Memory files are human-readable and hand-editable — you will edit them, and a consolidation that mangles your edits is a failed run.

since.description: When this became true. Relative dates are always converted to absolute.

evidence.description: Journal entries, decisions or records this was promoted from.

contradicts.description: Unresolved conflicts with other memory files. Present means the human still owes a decision.

in_claude_md.description: Whether this appears in the machine-maintained block of CLAUDE.md, so every future session starts informed.

hand_edited.description: Set when the human has edited the file. /consolidate must preserve the edit rather than overwrite it.
